data.body:
CLOSED. Two gate corrections were needed after the merge, recorded here rather than forced:

1. The close's completion precheck REFUSED the first attempt, correctly: the merged commit
   e795f5521cf touches src/rebar/_snapshot/gc_trigger.py, which the recorded file_impact did
   not declare (it listed only stamped_lock, enrich_drain, compact_trigger and the new test) —
   even though the plan Scope and the pre-implementation inventory both name gc_trigger as the
   THIRD copy. So the omission was in the recorded impact, not in the work. Fixed with
   rebar set-file-impact, now declaring all five changed paths with per-path reasons.

2. Widening file_impact is a material plan change, so the plan-review attestation went
   stale-material and rebar review-plan was re-run: verdict PASS, two findings triaged to
   'defer' (P6 priority 0.40 and E3 priority 0.00, both far below the 0.95 block line),
   material_fingerprint 22e9c17f8353148e. The first sign attempt returned
   PlanReviewGenerationRetryable ('generation remained unstable after 3 attempts', flagged
   retryable by the tool itself); the sanctioned no-LLM path rebar sign-review succeeded on
   the immediate retry, signing at head e795f5521cf. No --force was used at any point.

The close then passed the completion verifier and transitioned in_progress -> closed,
unblocking 3436-71db-ceff-4ac0.
